script:
BEFORE=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --field items | jq -c '[.[].id]')
COUNT=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq "$COUNT" --save F06.restart-persist/count
AFTER=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --field items | jq -c '[.[].id]')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
REPLAY=$(control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$CID" --query resend_mode=all --duration 3 \
  --save F06.restart-persist/replay | jq -r .saved)
jq -e --argjson ids "$AFTER" '[.frames[] | select(.direction == "received") | .frame | select(.key != "full_state") | .id] == $ids' "$REPLAY"
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_AFTER_RESTART"}]}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query sort_order=TIMESTAMP_DESC --query limit=2 \
  --check items.1.llm_message.content.0.text eq QA_F06_AFTER_RESTART
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . gt "$COUNT"
